approach.label: — APPROACH
approach.body: Learn the why before the how. Build small things well before scaling. That's the whole plan.

aether.description: Modern landing page exploring minimalist design principles and smooth interactions.

2048.description: Classic 2048 puzzle game implementation. Focused on clean game logic and state management.

yatzy.description: Traditional Yatzy game with full rules implementation and score tracking.

stasis.description: Experimental landing page with focus on typography and visual hierarchy.

hdufndsk.description: Social platform built in collaboration with Deathtrip. Features user authentication, posts, and community interactions.

kropp-fitness.description: My first landing page. Built with pure HTML and CSS to master fundamentals of web design and layout.

skrekkeparken.description: Interactive Halloween map-game for school project. Combines storytelling with interactive elements and animations.

date-time.description: Beautiful animated wallpaper engine theme featuring live clock and date updates. Demonstrates elegant use of setInterval() and CSS animations.

redbeardvfx.description: Portfolio landing page for VFX supervisor specializing in film, series, and commercial visual effects. Features contact form and project showcase.

todo-react.description: Full-stack todo application demonstrating React fundamentals with complete CRUD operations. Vanilla backend with proper API structure. First serious React project proving junior-level competency.

interactive-dashboard.description: Data visualization dashboard with real-time updates and interactive charts. Focus on responsive design and user experience.

nordic-market.description: E-commerce platform showcasing Nordic design products. Full shopping cart, payment integration, and admin panel.

background.label: — BACKGROUND
background.body:
I'm Amadi Masuev — a first-year student at Porsgrunn videregående skole, IT and media production. I got into programming because I wanted to understand how things are built, not just how to use them.

Working toward a career in the Norwegian tech industry as a fullstack developer. Particularly interested in system architecture and AI integration.

learning.label: — LEARNING PATH
learning.subtitle: Where I am, where I'm going.

items.title: Why before how.
items.body: I want to understand architecture and trade-offs, not just glue together code that runs.

items.title: Small things, well built.
items.body: Four projects shipped properly beat twenty half-finished experiments.

items.title: Clear structure.
items.body: Clean code, clear names, low noise. Same feeling I want visually.

hero.line2: Short or long, I'll read it.

notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or was moved. Nothing broken — just a wrong turn.
